This product was one of my favorites, it has always been a clear liquid. For my most recent purchase, the product is the color of olive oil. Due to this inconsistency, I don't dare to use this product and am concerned with the color.
Feels good on. I like the sheen. Much better packaging than the clunky plastic stuff

I've used this for years and really depend on it. Does not irritate skin - I use it after cleansing, about 1/2 of the dropper full. Then add moisturizer on - either bouncy facial or another treatment cream. I love using oil on my face - it's not too heavy - just right! Works great and I highly recommend it!!

avis.titre: Love it, but be warned before purchasing
avis.texte: I have been using for about 6 months and it has made a huge difference in my overall texture. It did go rancid before I could finish so I would recommend only purchasing the smaller size.

Don't be turned off by the smell… this is a NATURAL product!!! If you want something smelling like flowers or candy, you will need to head to a product with synthetic ingredients and/or additives. If you are looking for a clean beauty product, give it a try. I have dry/combination skin that is ridiculously sensitive. I have breakouts when the seasons change, it's windy, too little moisture in my products/too much in the products, washing less than twice a day, cycle time, I'm outside, the sun is shining (not literally all those things, but you get the picture). My skin is temperamental and needs a product that can balance it out. Well, found it! I was skeptical about this product because it's an oil. I was surprised to find how well it absorbed into my skin leaving it soft and did not leave it greasy or cause any breakouts. I've been using it for about 3 months now and I have zero complaints. If you follow the directions and do 2-3 drops at night, you might enjoy the results. Always take a few minutes and massage it in! Our skin loves massages, and that too helps with the fine lines and wrinkles. I was told years ago by a dermatologist to allow skincare products at least 6 months to see full results. The only thing that works overnight is surgery, and even that has a healing time to see the final product, so if you try it, be patient with the process. Yes, it is pricey. Yes, I think DE is geared for mature skin. Yes, it's worth it.

avis.titre: Ya'll better come and get this
avis.texte: OMG I LOVE LOVE THIS OIL I wish my local stores had more of it in stock . I have sensitive skin and this works so well for me. Mixed with Protini it's the bomb

As mentioned in otger reviews, im a former cancer patient now working with cancer patients to make a less bumpy ride through treatment. Skin is a major issue diring treatment. It flakes off, dries out, prunes up and leaves you feeling even worse than you already did. I liked this oil because its easy, effective, and lasts. If youre in treatment, youre not going to do a 15 step morning/night skin regime. With this, you can even use a face wipe and then dot it on. What a gift to have smoothe skin again! I will have to be careful who j recommend it to, because as noted, the price point. But hey-if the company wver wants to do a good deed- hit me up! I make gift baskets of donated products for oatients from all natural companies with heart.

I am such a huge fan of Drunk Elephant, and A-Passioni has been a staple in my daily routine for years now so I was so excited to try this. In such a short time, I've already begun to notice improvement in my hyperpigmentation, and my skin is literally glowing! Gifted by Drunk Elephant

I've been offered by drunkelephant to try out the Drunk Elephant A-Gloei Maretinol Oil and it's definitely a game-changer for those new to retinol. It's gentle and enriched with marula oil, so it keeps the skin hydrated while you benefit from the retinol's renewing effects. The texture is lighter than I expected, making it quite pleasant for my combination skin. I integrate it into my PM skincare routine, and always remember to apply sunscreen during the day, as retinol can make your skin more sensitive to the sun. If you're looking to dip your toes into the world of retinol, this oil could be a great start—just be sure to protect your skin from UV exposure!

Have been trying it for two weeks, I haven't seen major changes but I do like how it makes my skin feel. My skin feels hydrated and smooth with a natural glow. Can't wait to see what it does for my hyperpigmentation. This is a great oil for someone thinking of starting retinol, like myself. Gifted by drunk elephant.

I love the brand, so I was really excited to try their A Gloei Retinol Oil. There is an interesting combination of ingredients inside, and I have been using retinol for years now. I didn't notice any kind of bad smell – to me, it smells okay. However, for that amount of money, I would prefer something a little bit stronger in action. But it's good for beginners though. gifted by drunkelephant

I love the brand, so I was really excited to try their A Gloei Retinol Oil. There is an interesting combination of ingredients inside, and I have been using retinol for years now. I didn't notice any kind of bad smell – to me, it smells okay. However, for that amount of money, I would prefer something a little bit stronger in action. But it's good for beginners though. gifted by drunkelephant

This product was gifted by Drunk Elephant. I have normal/combo skin with some fine lines, dark spots, texture and occasional blemishes. Firstly I must address the scent. To me, this smells like rancid, old cooking oil like opening a bottle of expired vegetable oil. Upon looking into this issue it seems that some people have been told by customer service that it's supposed to smell that way because they don't use anything to cover up the natural scent. I've smelled and used several face oils without fragrance and they've never smelled this horrible. If this is truly the scent it is supposed to be then steer clear if you're sensitive to the smell. If there are batches going around that have gone bad then that's another issue all on its own. Personally I do not feel that a natural oil should be smelling this rank and I cannot stand to use it on my face because the smell is just so strong. I have been using it on my chest and arms/hands though as I typically extend my skincare to those areas anyway. I do like that it absorbs in pretty well and doesn't leave behind a lot of residue but I do give it about 15 minutes to sink in fully before getting dressed or going to bed. My hands/arms, which are typically pretty dry, are looking hydrated and supple so it does seem to work well in terms of skincare benefits. I'm taking off two stars for the suspicious smell but if you can get past it I do think the product is pretty good.

Ok I was worried about trying retinol but this is so gentle. The oil is very nourishing and moisturizing. Great for mixing into a moisturizer or even alone on top of moisturizer! Very good for us sensitive skin folks. *offered by drunkelephant

Gifted by drunkelephant in exchange for an honest review - great oil based option that includes retinol. It's suitable for both new and experienced users with retinol which I love. It takes a minute to absorb but gives a great glow

This oil has turned out to be a nice addition to my skincare routine.It is very lightweight and gentle on the skin. I've noticed that it helps my skin rebuild the barrier after irritation.I use it every night before going to bed with Gua Sha,I massage it in thoroughly and notice that my skin looks more firm and less textured. I appreciate a lot that the brand is socially responsible and conscious,and it's vegan and clean,which means a lot to me.I also love that it contains ceramides,which I've noticed work great for my skin,especially with pigmentation.However, I'm not a big fan of how it smells,as it has a weird scent,and the absorbance is not as good as I would wish it to be. The product was offered by Drunk Elephant.

LOVEDDDD this oil, I just added it to my skin care essentials because it makes my face feel amazing and it's so easy to use! Definitely recommend especially if you have dry skin because this will help you! Gifted by drunkelephant

avis.titre: Light on the skin and smooth
avis.texte: I love how it makes my skin feel, also love that unlike the prescription version which is stronger I don't have purging , dry skin or peeling. Overall just makes my skin appear smoother after a few uses. Offered by drunelephant

This retinol oil is truly remarkable! Despite having sensitive, combination, and acne-prone skin, I've found it gentle enough for regular use without any breakouts. After just a few days of consistent application, I've noticed my skin tone evening out and a healthy glow overall. Plus, I'm experiencing fewer breakouts. I'm seriously impressed and will definitely repurchase when I finish this bottle. It's absolutely worth the investment. Offered by drunkelephant

Gifted by DrunkElephant. I rarely buy Drunk Elephant so I was glad to get the opportunity to try this face oil. It comes in a nice bottle with dropper for easy dispensing. The oil is an oil so it is runny. It has a weird natural scent but it didn't bother me. The oil surprisingly did not make my face feel greasy. My skin absorbed it and it did make it feel nourished and hydrated. I love that it helps protect your barrier. It is gentle for containing retinol. I am looking forward to the long term results of using this oil.

Gifted by drunk elephant I absolutely love this maretinol oil from Drunk elephant I love the way that it helps to clear up my skin. I would highly recommend all my family and friends. I use this in my daytime skincare routine, and I will be purchasing as product again.🐘

Great oil! It doesn't feel heavy and it absorbs quickly, it does a good job at evening out my skin texture and I love using it before I go in with my guasha, I recommend it if your looking for a nice face oil, gifted by drunk elephant

The Drunk Elephant Maretinol Oil offers the potency of retinol with a gentler formulation. It feels moisturizing, but slightly heavy on the skin and does have an unpleasant scent. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.
I've been using for a few weeks and it really minimizes the look of lines. It gives lots of moisture and a little Bit goes a long way. I love how my face is glowing

OMG DRUNK ELEPHANT!!! I am totally obsessed with this face oil. I really do love how it just immediately sunk into my skin and just fell totally nourishing for my face. I do recommend trying a little bit first just to see how your skin reacts to it but then once you know, it tolerates it I definitely recommend using at night time. Gifted by drunk elephant.

A-GLOEI MARULA OIL by Drunk Elephant is a luxurious treat for the skin. It's lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling incredibly soft and hydrated. I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin's texture and overall radiance since incorporating this oil into my skincare routine. Plus, knowing that it's formulated with clean, effective ingredients gives me peace of mind. Overall, I highly recommend this oil for anyone looking to add a boost of hydration and glow to their skincare regimen.

This face oil is lightweight and very gentle on the skin. It makes my skin soft and smooth. I've been using this product for a few days, and my skin looks healthier. I can't wait to see better results soon. Complimentary from Drunk Elephant.

This face oil is really nice for my combination skin, I like that it's not too heavy and when I put this on in the evening it makes my face smooth and glowy. I also like that it's gentle and doesn't make my skin sensitive. Gifted by drunkelephant

Gifted by DrunkElephant. This is another amazing Drunk Elephant product! This is a retinol oil based serum & it is super nourishing for the skin. My skin feels hydrated & renewed after using it. I love that it can be paired under other skincare because it is an oil based serum.

This was gifted by drunkelephant, but is my far the greatest retinol I have ever tried in my life. With one use, I felt like my acne scars and pigmentation lessened drastically just overnight. I literally stopped using foundation since using this because I'm so much more confident with my natural skin!!!!!!

I recently tried the Gloei Maretinol Oil from Drunk Elephant, and it's absolutely amazing! This retinol face oil effectively minimizes fine lines, hyperpigmentation, blemishes, and sun damage while keeping my skin moisturized and glowing. The inclusion of soothing marula oil and ceramides ensures that it's gentle on the skin, without any redness or irritation. Plus, it's vegan, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging. After using it few times, my skin's hydration, firmness, and brightness improved significantly. I highly recommend giving it a try for a healthier and more radiant complexion! Gifted by drunk elephant

avis.titre: Ideal for mature and dry skin
avis.texte: This facial oil is a gentle yet powerful retinol treatment, perfect for reducing blemishes and hyperpigmentation. While it's a bit heavier than expected, it pairs beautifully with my moisturizers. I've learned to apply it sparingly to avoid any heaviness. Ideal for mature and dry skin, like mine. complimentary from drunk elephant

With this oil a little goes a long way. Packaging says 2-3 drops, but even 3 drops is a lot and creates a greasy mess that'll take forever to get absorbed into the skin. I go with 2 small drops and that's enough for my entire face. It works well with my regular serums and moisturizer. I have to see its effectiveness in long term. Gifted by DrunkElephant

Complimentary from drunkelephant I can't say instant result about most products, but this product produces an instant result. You can feel it tingling when you apply it and it truly makes a difference in your skin.There is no after-oily feel and goes well under moisturizer and/or make up

This oil does a great job of leaving my skin looking plump and feeling moisturized when I first apply. I like that with continued use of this product it helped my skin's texture to feel smoother and helped brighten my skin's overall tone. Overall great product. Complimentary from Drunk Elephant

I was gifted by drunk elephant. A nice gentle retinol I have been using for 2 weeks now about 3 times a week. Significantly better skin texture and lightening of my hyperpigmentation in my cheeks. I haven't had any sensitivity and I have dry skin so it hasn't affected my skin at all wear it dries it out more just a nice balance. I use this mainly at night as well.

This retinol will not make your skin red even if you are sensitive since both myself and my boyfriend tried it and we are both different skin type. It's super gentle yet efficient. Our skin looks more radiante, smoother and pump. We used at night and in the morning our skin looks super moisturized. I was gifted by drunkelephant

I received this product offered by DrunkElephant in exchange for my honest review. First of all I wanna say I love this brand so I was super excited to try out this product. My skin feels super hydrated and smooth after I use it and gives my skin a glowy look. It's been helping get rid of some of the hyperpigmentation on my cheeks as well. Over all a great product that I highly recommend.

I received complimentary from Drunk Elephant. Hyperpigmentation is my biggest concern as pertaining to my skin, so using a face oil that provides some protection against dark spots and even tone is simply a win in my opinion. A gentle dose of retinol combined with ceramides works to keep clear and even toned.

Gifted by Drunk Elephant. I've enjoyed using this retinol because it doesn't irritate my skin like others do so I can definitely say this works good for sensitive skin. It feels very nice on the skin upon application and it absorbs easily. I am excited to continue using it and see skin improvements!

avis.titre: Part of my nightly routine now
avis.texte: It absorbs into my skin really quickly, which I love because I hate that greasy feeling some oils can leave behind. Since I started using it, my skin feels so much softer and looks glowier. It doesn't irritate my skin or break me out, which can be a dealbreaker with new skincare products. It's a bit of an investment, but in my opinion, totally worth it for how great it makes my skin feel and look. Offered by drunkelephant for my honest review!

Even though my skin is recently met with retinol, I'm so happy that this %0.5 retinol did not irritate my skin. Maybe because it's an oil formula or my skin is now used to it. My first impression was very positive with this retinol oil. I can't wait to see the long term results. The packaging is a solid metal this time not plastic like other DE products, feels nice and cool to touch. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

After giving this oil a try, I'm so happy with it! It easily absorbed into my skin and makes it so smooth and soft. I also love the subtle glow that it gives me. It doesn't make me feel sticky nor too oily. Perfect for my dry skin! Packaging is also super secure and sleek. I was gifted by drunk elephant!

This oil is so good and I love the way it looks on my skin. I feel like it is so hydrating and nice on my skin. It is so good for me. My dry skin needs this oil to keep it hydrated and smooth and soft gifted by drunk elephant

This oil is my new favorite product. My skin is glowing and dewy and gives off a glass like complexion. My fine lines are a lot less noticeable and just feels so much more hydrated. I apply at night with my other products and I am loving my results so far. It was gifted by drunkelephant

O have been loving this AGloei Maretinol oil from Drunk Elephant. I had never used retinol in this oil form but i love it, it leaves my skin hydrated and i love how it makes my skin feel and look. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

I've been loving this on nights where I basically just want to do one step of skincare and go to bed: it moisturizes while still giving me the anti-aging benefits. I haven't noticed any irritation thus far but i'm also a long-time retinol/retinoid user. this was gifted by drunk elephant for my honest review.

avis.titre: Love the oil version of retinol
avis.texte: As someone who has extremely dry skin, this oil works really well and seeps into the skin. I've only tried cream version of retinol before but I prefer the oil version for my dry skin. It has really helped my skin clear up without being too harsh. Gifted by drunkelephant

This product is so great! It helped make my skin feel so soft and hydrated and gave me a natural glow. It also helped to reduce my hyperpigmentation and find lines. I highly recommend this product! Love it. Gifted by drunk elephant

This oil was gifted by Drunk Elephant. This Drunk Elephant oil is easy to use and I can see a difference with my skin. It smoothed out my skin texture and gave it a healthy glow. It also helped with my hyperpigmentation and didn't irritate my skin.

This is the best product I could ever use on my skin. It cleared up my acne so quickly and flawlessly without drying my skin out. I've gotten so much compliments on my skin after using this facial oil. I'm considering to switching my routine to everything drunk elephant. So so good!

I received this A-Gloei Maretinol Oil complimentary from Drunk Elephant. I apply this oil at night and it has been helping to keep my skin hydrated and also reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.

I received this product complimentary from Drunk Elephant. Love this oil so much! My skin is hydrated, moisturized, smooth and with natural glow. I use it daily at night time and I can see a difference. It minimizes the look of lines. I would highly recommend it to anyone to try it out!

This is a gentle retinol option, so the anti-aging effects are gradual. I haven't noticed dramatic wrinkle reduction, but my skin texture feels smoother and looks a bit more even-toned. One thing that surprised me is how hydrating this oil is! The virgin marula oil keeps my skin feeling plump and nourished, even with the retinol. No dryness or irritation here. As someone with sensitive skin, I was worried about irritation with retinol. Thankfully, this oil has been very gentle and hasn't caused any breakouts. Gifted by Drunk Elephant

A gentle 0.5% concentration vegan retinol can help improve the look and feel of uneven skin tone and texture. The oil is easy to absorb no greasy feeling. Ceramides help fill in the spaces between skin cells, giving them elasticity, and play a critical role in strengthening the skin barrier. This formula is great for entry-level retinol user too. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.
I had high hopes and so regret this purchase now. The oil went rancid very quickly, there are about 3/4 left and the smell is horrible. Unusable, even on my back. Very different to their Marula Oil.
One of the few retinols that doesn't irritate my sensitive skin!! I have no visible signs of aging, so can't speak to its anti-aging properties.

I am shocked by how much I like this. I usually don't use oils because they don't sink in and just feels uncomfortable on my face. Not only did this sink in quickly, did not leave an oily feeling, but it made my skin really soft! Definitely worth the price

I used this once every 3 nights for about 4 months. I loved the texture and how moisturizing it was, but I developed deep pimples more often than usual. I know retinols have a purging stage so I continued using, but after 4 months I decided to stop use and my skin has returned to normal. I also didnt notice any anti-aging properties. Maybe this works well for other people but a good Ulta rating doesn't mean it will be effective for everyone :(
I can't tell if this is doing anything and it had a rancid smell right out of the box. I have loved several other Drunk Elephant products, but this is not one I would purchase again.

It irritates my skin :( I really wanted to like it. It makes my skin red and blotchy when I use it (it goes away, but that's disconcerting). I don't have sensitive skin when using other products, but my skin just doesn't like this guy! After my first week of using it (I mixed it with the B-Hydra Hydration Serum) - it made my skin white and flakey. I've been using heavy duty CeraVe cream for weeks just to get it back to normal. I DO love the Hydration Serum. But I guess my skin just doesn't like retinol.

It works well on my skin, however, it went rancid really fast. I can't even use it anymore and it's about half full or more. I see your explanation to the reviewer below me, about not using masking or fragrance, which is great, one of the reasons I love drunk elephant! But this is different. Rancid oil has a distinct smell and I'm smelling that here. Too bad because my spots are lighter and my face looks smooth. I would like to try the regular retinol cream.

this is amazing. gets rid of lines and pimples overnight for me. i can see a difference in a week. i'm on my 4th bottle. definitely worth the money. the bottle is so cute. the smell is kinda off but it is worth it for the affect.

As much as I love Drunk Elephant skin care products, this is probably my least favorite one. I like using retinol daily in the evening on my face, but this product is an oil, which I just really do not like. It takes a long while to absorb my skin, and my face just feels really gross until it absorbs. I will continue to use retinol in a serum instead of in this product.
Works great and I can see improvement in my skin. I feel like the fine lines are less since I use it. I just don't like the smell.
I am a frequent user of retinol, but this product is not it. The texture and the smell were great, but the result on my skin was not pleasant or worth the money.

I was very pleasantly suprised with this retinol oil. It absorbs well and feels like is really melting into the skin, making it feel dewy and plump. This product feels hydrating but not greasy, unlike other facial oils Ive tried. The retinol is gentle and non-iritating. It felt like my skin cleared up and looked brighter while using this and the C-Firma serum. I appreciate the way this line is fomulated to all work together. Ultimately, I'll be repurchasing.

First time using retinol. Its been just a couple weeks and i think it lightened a dark spot one shade. Hopefully it keeps getting better. Forehead lines look softer. Skin looks better all around. Using with the littles kit. Smells strong, but its working so i dont care. Kind of like a primrose oil smell. Thankful its not masked w fragrance.
The most gentle, hydrating retinol treatment I've used! I have sensitive skin and this is one of the few retinol products that isn't irritating

This oil has changed my skin texture! I bought this oil a month ago and I use it in my day and night skin routine. I apply it after I cleanse my face and this has made my skin so smooth. I used to have rough skin on my neck and jawline and they have disappeared. My skin is also more moisturized than ever!

Myself, I was not a huge fan of this product and I love everything Drunk Elephant. It is very greasy on my face and I feel like it clogs my pores. Since I had high expectations, I purchased a large bottle. I dont want to waste it so I add alittle to my body lotion and it does seem to help with summertime dryness.

This is, in my opinion, an unconventional way to get your retinol. You are going to need to like face oils to like this. There are to many other ways to get retinol that are gentle so if oils are not your thing, this is going to be a big Nope. That being said, DE does recommend mixing so if you use Lala for example, you can mix but it still has that thicker oily feel. I've been using this for about one month. I'd say it's on par with most basic retinols and not really special. It's an interesting concept in an oil and not bad. Good for mixing and does do what a retinol is supposed to do but without irritation.

I bought this months ago as a sample and I'm in love. Being brown skin with sensitive skin, I also try to find the perfect product for me. I was skeptical about trying retinol in my face but this work wonders. When I stopped using it for a while I did see the difference without it being in my skincare routine so I bought more. I'm not sure why some people don't like the smell. It doesn't bother me at all I mix it with TLC and topped it with F-Balm and it's amazing on my skin. People have to remember not all product work well for everyone.
This is one of the few retinol products that doesn't irritate my sensitive skin! It's also super hydrating and can be used as a daily moisturizer

Definitely not for me! I was so excited to use this after seeing many positive reviews on other sites. However, I was left greatly underwhelmed by the lack of reduction of my dark spots. I also disliked the thickness of the oil. It felt like I had Vaseline on my face, as the oil never fully absorbed. It was gross, but I still gave it a fair shot. For reference, I did give this a solid try for 8 weeks with no visible signs of improvement.

This product is marketed as being marula oil + retinol and ceramides, but having used it, I can confirm what other reviewers are saying: it smells like cooking oil and does not behave at all like marula oil. It sits on the surface of your skin and doesn't feel good. And yes, the smell although faint is reminiscent of canola and at first I thought it had gone rancid. I believe that the amount of soy oil that they cut this product with makes it a poor product compared to their (excellent) marula oil.

This product is a powerhouse miracle worker. Its a gentle and effective retinol oil, that helps reduce blemishes and hyperpigmentation. I've been using this product for a few months, and since then I've noticed my blemishes heal faster, and my dark spots have faded. The oil is lightweight, and doesn't feel greasy on my skin either. I would absolutely recommend this product.

initially received a sample of this from my step mom. noticed a difference in my skin's texture and appearance immediately—seriously, this stuff is goooood. i don't ordinarily spend this much on a single product, but this one is worth it. the full size seems like it will last a good long while, too.
I'm not a huge face oil fan but I actually quite like this one. It doesn't leave behind the typically oil greasy texture that you normally get with oils. I really enjoy using this at night.
Drunk Elephant and Shiseido (The company that owns D.E.) are both truly the peak of luxury and quality in ALL skincare.
A little bit goes a long way little bit pricey but it's okay cause it's worth it last a long time

While I realize this product is not for moisturizing, as an oil, it goes on nicely and I feel it is helping (with the other Drunk Elephant products and wish I had discovered this line years earlier. I use it every night and it does not break out my very sensitive skin. Really like it.

I absolutely LOVE the A-Gloei product. I saw a differnce in my 52 ys old skin immediately after 1 day, 1 week and now 3 months. I use it every other day and the texture of my skin is so much smoother and radiant than it was when I was using other products. I am just now adding in the F Balm so I am excited to see how this works as I have friends who use it and say it is the holy grail!
This is gentle on the face and leaves skin feeling soooo soft! I'm obsessed!
Unfortunately, the soybean oil has a strong smell at first. I trust their products but I likely will not purchase this specific product again as the smell reminds me cooking.
I've seen a big improvement in my skin since using this product. My skin has cleared up and looks brighter! Definitely will be buying again
A little goes along way! Soaks I'm well skin feels smoother I have only used it for 2 weeks so still happy with the short term results
I pair it with the retinol as a part of my day routine. Spreads easily, and is super gentle.
I love this stuff! My skin looks and feels more healthy as soon as it is on!
It is a must in your routine. Mixing this oil with your serum helps your skin to absorb, and prevents the dryness after the serum. It keeps your skin soft during the day.

avis.titre: I wish this was like the sample
avis.texte: I received a sample of A Gloei and loved it ! I shared some of the sample with my daughter she loved it as well so I bought the full size for her. Upon receiving the full size bottle she was excited but when she opened it to put it on she was disappointed, The color was not the same full size is yellow sample was clear , the smell is different as well and it doesn't absorb as quickly as the sample!
